description: Add Solvr auto-registration to init.sh — detect no key, offer registration, auto-register agent
steps: In init.sh, before IPFS pinning section, check if solvr.apiKey exists in config
If no key: prompt 'Register on Solvr for free IPFS + collective knowledge?'
If yes: call POST https://api.solvr.dev/v1/agents/register with agent name
Parse response: extract api_key, agent.id, pinning_quota_bytes
Store api_key in config.json under solvr.apiKey AND apiKeys.solvr
Display: '✅ Registered as {agent_id}! 1GB free pinning included.'
Auto-configure ipfs.provider to 'solvr' since key now exists
Verify: fresh init with no Solvr key prompts and successfully registers

description: Add Solvr key validation to init.sh — verify existing key works before proceeding
steps: If solvr.apiKey exists in config, call GET https://api.solvr.dev/v1/me
If 200: display 'Already registered as {display_name} on Solvr ✓'
If 401/403: warn 'Solvr key invalid', offer to re-register or enter new key
Store validated agent info (id, display_name) in config for reference
Verify: init with valid key shows agent name, invalid key triggers re-registration offer

description: Add claim invitation message after Solvr registration — guide user to link agent to human account
steps: After successful registration in init.sh, display claim instructions
Message: 'To link me to your human account: solvr.dev/agents/me/claim'
Explain: 'Optional but gives you control over my settings and reputation'
Store claim_url in config.json for reference
Add 'proactive-amcp claim-info' command to display claim URL anytime
Verify: new registration shows claim URL, claim-info command works

description: Link AMCP identity to Solvr agent — prove cryptographic identity on Solvr profile
steps: After AMCP identity created and Solvr registered, call Solvr API to link them
Sign a challenge with AMCP private key to prove ownership
Call PUT/PATCH endpoint to set has_amcp_identity=true and store AID
Display: 'AMCP identity linked to Solvr — your checkpoints are now verifiable'
Add verification badge info to claim-info output
Verify: Solvr /me endpoint shows has_amcp_identity:true after init

description: Add auth expiry monitoring to watchdog — catch OAuth expiration before agent dies
steps: In watchdog.sh health checks, run 'openclaw models status --check'
Parse exit code: 0=OK, 1=expired (too late), 2=expiring soon
If exit 2: send Telegram alert 'OAuth expiring soon — renew at console.anthropic.com'
If exit 1: trigger resurrection flow immediately
Add auth_status to diagnose.sh output
Verify: watchdog detects expiring OAuth and alerts before death

description: Add soul-evil hook detection to watchdog — alert if personality override hook is enabled
steps: In watchdog.sh, check for soul-evil hook: 'openclaw hooks list | grep soul-evil'

Check if hook was enabled during a 'purge window' (suspicious timing)
Add to diagnose.sh output under security_checks
Verify: watchdog detects soul-evil hook and alerts

description: Add 'proactive-amcp status --full' — comprehensive status including Solvr, IPFS, watchdog health
steps: Create comprehensive status command that shows all subsystem health
Include: identity (valid/invalid), Solvr (registered/key valid), IPFS (provider/last pin)
Include: watchdog (running/last check), checkpoints (count/last CID), auth (OK/expiring)
Include: learning storage stats (problems/learnings count)
Output both human-readable and --json formats
Verify: status --full shows complete system health

description: Add solvr-register.sh standalone script — allow registration outside of init flow
steps: Create scripts/solvr-register.sh for standalone Solvr registration
Accept --name flag for custom agent name, default to hostname

Store key in config.json, update storage.provider to solvr
Show claim URL after successful registration
Add 'register' subcommand to proactive-amcp.sh dispatcher
Verify: 'proactive-amcp register' works standalone
